# Documentation

Read [coding instructions](../copilot-instructions.md). Keep documentation specific to the working site and verify commands against repository configuration.

- README is the entry point, content editing lives in `docs/CONTENT_WORKFLOW.md`, and hosting instructions live in `docs/AMPLIFY_DEPLOYMENT.md`.
- Keep troubleshooting focused on observed build, styling and PDF issues.
- Link to a single maintained source instead of duplicating setup guides.
- Update relative links when moving or deleting documents.
- Avoid generic theme examples, unsupported deployment options and inaccurate proficiency claims.
- Preserve LICENSE and font/vendor permission notices.
- Format Markdown with Prettier and check local links before delivery.
